name: Roasted Fennel-Quinoa Salad with Arugula, Dates, Pistachios & Feta

instructions.primary_message: In a medium saucepan, combine quinoa and broth; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups quinoa
710 ml chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
6 fennel bulbs
1 ½ lemons
1 ½ bunches radish
1 small bunch fresh dill
1 ½ (142 g) pkgs baby arugula

instructions.primary_message: Trim off root end and stalks of the fennel, leaving only the white bulbs. Halve fennel bulbs lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin half-moons. Divide between two large baking sheet pans, drizzle with oil, then season with salt and pepper. Stir to combine and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place fennel in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until slightly browned and tender, 20-25 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, juice lemons into a large bowl. Add oil, maple syrup, and spices, then whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tbsp pure maple syrup
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper
½ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Trim and halve radishes, then slice crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Roughly chop dates and pistachios. Add both to the bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup medjool dates, pitted
1 cup pistachios, unsalted

instructions.primary_message: Transfer the cooked quinoa to a third large baking sheet. Spread out in an even layer and let cool for 5 minutes.
Add cooled fennel and quinoa to the bowl, along with arugula and feta, then toss to combine the salad.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (113 g) pkgs crumbled feta cheese

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
